why: El AI engineer wallet men akther el profilet elli tetlab fi Tounes w barra, surtout fel remote m3a charikat ourobiya. 9bal ma tebni applications, lezem tefhem chnoua ya3mel el métier hedha w kifech yekhdem LLM men dekhel: tokens, cost, limites.
outcome: tfasser chnoua ya3mel AI engineer, tefhem tokens, context window w hallucinations, t7seb el cost mta3 requête b el prix el s7a7, ta5tar model, w ta3mel awel appel l Claude b Python b tari9a safe.

lessons.title: Chnoua ya3mel AI engineer?
text: AI engineer howa developer yebni applications fihom el intelligence artificielle: chatbot yjaweb el clients, outil y9ra factures w ye5raj menhom data, assistant y3awen équipe support... Houwa ma ydarrebch el model men el sfer: yesta3mel models jahzin kima Claude 3abr API, w ykhammem fel produit kamel: el prompt, el data elli yab3athha, el code elli y7awet el model, el cost, el sécurité, w kifech el 7aja tekhdem mli7 fel production w tet7assen m3a el wa9t.

Fama confusion barcha bin el métiers. El data scientist y7allel data w ya3mel modèles statistiques bech yjaweb 3la so2el business. El ML engineer ydarreb w y déployi modèles machine learning (des fois men el sfer) w yekhdem barcha m3a pipelines mta3 data w GPU. El software developer yebni applications 3adiyin. El AI engineer fel wost: 3andou les réflexes mta3 developer (code ndhif, tests, API, déploiement) w yzid 3lihom fehm mta3 LLM: prompts, evaluation, cost w limites.

Les skills elli tetlab: Python mli7 (w chwaya JavaScript ynaf3ek), API REST w JSON, Git, chwaya SQL, w fehm mta3 LLM. Ba3d tzid: tool use w agents, RAG w vector databases, evaluation, monitoring. El soft skills zeda mouhemmin: tfasser lel client chnoua el AI tnajem ta3mel w chnoua ma tnajemch, w tekteb b clarté, 5ater 7atta el prompt houwa ktiba.

El marché: fi Tounes fama startups w ESN ykhadmou fi projets AI l clients ourobiyin, w fama charikat ourobiya ta5dem b remote m3a juniors tounsiyin. El freelance zeda ymchi (chatbots, automatisation, intégrations), ama lezmek portfolio y7arrek. El track hedha ymchi khatwa b khatwa: tawa el bases, ba3d prompt engineering, ba3d Claude API b el tafsil, tool use w agents, RAG, w fel le5er el production: monitoring, cost w evaluation.
points: AI engineer = developer yebni produits b models jahzin, mouch chercheur ydarreb models.
ML engineer ydarreb w y déployi models; data scientist y7allel data; AI engineer y intégri LLM fi produit.
Python, API, JSON w Git homa el asas; el fehm mta3 LLM yji fou9hom.
Portfolio b projets s7a7 ynaf3ek akther men liste twila mta3 certificats.

lessons.title: Kifech yekhdem LLM: token w next token
text: LLM (Large Language Model) houwa model t3allem 3la kammiya kbira barcha men el texte. El fekra el asasiya bsita: ta3tih bdaya mta3 texte, w houwa y9ayyem chnoua el bout elli ba3dou. Ma yefhemch kima el insen: y7seb probabilités, y3ti score l kol bout possible, w ya5tar wa7ed. Ba3d yzid el bout hedha lel texte w y3awed, bout b bout, 7atta ykammel el jaweb.

El bout hedha esmou token. Token mouch dima kelma: tnajem tkoun kelma kamla, nos kelma, chwaya 7rouf, wala ponctuation. El model ma y9rach el 7rouf directement: el texte yetkassar l tokens, w kol token 3andou numéro. Ghaleb el wa9t, el texte b lougha ghir el anglais, kima el derja wala el 3arbi, ya5ou tokens akther l nafs el ma3na, w hedha y2atther 3al cost w 3al blasa fel prompt.

Fama zouz mara7el. El training (entraînement): el charika elli ta3mel el model tfawwet 3lih textes kbar w t3addel milliards mta3 paramètres 7atta y9ayyem el token el jey mli7, ba3d tzid mar7la bech y5allef el instructions w ykoun utile w safe. Hedhi tetkallef barcha w ma ta3melhech inti. El inference: wa9t elli inti tab3ath prompt 3abr API w el model y5arrej jaweb. El model ma yet3allemch men el conversation mte3ek: el paramètres ma yetbadlouch.

Men houni tefhem 3lech el model ynajem yghlot. Houwa ya5tar el texte elli ybén m3a9oul 7asb chnoua t3allem, mouch elli verifiyé. Ken el ma3louma ma kanetch fel training, wala 9dima, wala el so2el ghamedh, ya3tik jaweb mrattab w b thi9a... w ghalet. Zid 3liha: el model 3andou date limite lel connaissances mte3ou (knowledge cutoff), w ma ya3rafch chnoua sar ba3dha ken ma 3titouhech inti fel prompt.
points: LLM y9ayyem el token el jey, token b token, 7atta ykammel el jaweb.
Token = bout mta3 texte; el cost w el limites kolhom b tokens, mouch b kelmet.
Training ya3mlou el fournisseur marra; inference ta3mlou inti m3a kol requête.
Jaweb mrattab w b thi9a mouch ma3neh jaweb s7i7.

lessons.title: Context window, tokens w el cost
text: El context window hiya akbar kammiya tokens elli el model ynajem ychoufha fi requête wa7da: el system prompt, el historique mta3 el conversation, el documents elli 7atithom, w el jaweb elli bech yekteb. Fi Claude Opus 5.5, Sonnet 5.5 w Haiku 5.5, el context window 1M (milyoun) token, w el output yousel l 128K token. Ama 'ynajem' mouch ma3neha 'lezem': kol token tab3thou t5alsou.

El API ma tetfakkarch: kol requête lezem tab3ath fiha el conversation lkol men el awel. Ya3ni fi chatbot, kol ma tzid message, el input yekber w el cost yekber m3ah. El facturation b zouz ar9am: input tokens (chnoua tab3ath) w output tokens (chnoua y5arrej el model), w el output dima a8la. El prix b dollar l kol milyoun token (input / output): Opus 5.5 4$ / 20$, Sonnet 5.5 2$ / 10$, Haiku 5.5 0.10$ / 0.50$ (ken el prompt ma yfoutech 100K token; fou9 hekka 0.50$ / 2.50$), w Fable 5.1, el akwa, 10$ / 50$.

El 7seb bsit: cost = input_tokens × prix_input / 1 000 000 + output_tokens × prix_output / 1 000 000. Mithel: requête fiha 2 000 token input w 500 token output 3la Opus 5.5: 2 000 × 4 / 1M = 0.008$, w 500 × 20 / 1M = 0.010$, el majmou3 0.018$. Tbén chay? Ama ken 3andek 10 000 requête fel nhar, rahi 180$ fel nhar. Nafs el khedma 3la Haiku 5.5 ta5rej 4.50$ fel nhar. Hedha 3lech el choix mta3 el model w twoul el prompt mouhemmin barcha.

Bech ta3ref el 3dad b dhabt, ma t5ammench: el response fiha response.usage.input_tokens w response.usage.output_tokens, w 9bal ma tab3ath tnajem testa3mel client.messages.count_tokens. Ma testa3melch tiktoken: hedha tokenizer mta3 OpenAI w ya3tik 3dad ghalta l Claude. Zid a3ref elli el thinking mta3 el model (el tfakkir 9bal el jaweb) jouz2 men el output w ya7seb fi max_tokens, w tnajem tkontrolih b output_config effort. Fel cours el jeyin bech nchoufou prompt caching w Batches API (50% arkhess) bech tna99es el facture.
points: Context window = input + output fi requête wa7da; 1M token fel models el jdod.
El API stateless: kol requête t3awed tab3ath el historique lkol.
Fi Claude, el output token a8la b 5 marrat men el input token.
9is b usage w count_tokens, ma t5ammench, w ma testa3melch tiktoken.

example.note: Natija: Opus 5.5 180.00, Sonnet 5.5 90.00, Haiku 5.5 4.50 dollar fel nhar.

lessons.title: Familles mta3 models: kifech ta5tar model
text: Anthropic ta3mel Claude 3la niveaux. Opus 5.5 (claude-opus-5-5) houwa el model el par défaut: 9wi barcha fel code, el raisonnement w el khedma el twila. Sonnet 5.5 (claude-sonnet-5-5) qualité mli7a b nos el soum. Haiku 5.5 (claude-haiku-5-5) el asra3 w el arkhess, mrigel l volume kbir: classification, extraction, routage. W Fable 5.1 (claude-fable-5-1) houwa el akwa, l akther el mohemmat s3oubiya, ama a8la. Ista3mel el ids hedhom kif ma homa, bla date fel le5er.

Fama fournisseurs o5rin: OpenAI (GPT), Google (Gemini), Mistral (charika fransiya), w models 'open weights' kima Llama wala Mistral tnajem t7ottha 3la machine mte3ek wala serveur mte3ek, mathalan b Ollama. El open models ynaf3ou ki el data ma lezemhech to5rej men 3andek wala ki t7eb tkontroli kol chay, ama lezmek GPU w khedma fel hébergement, w ghaleb el wa9t el qualité a9al men el models el kbar.

El choix dima compromis bin 5 7ajet: qualité (yefhem w yraisonni mli7?), vitesse (latence, mouhemma l chatbot), cost (prix el token w 9addech men token yesta3mel), privacy (win temchi el data w chkoun ynajem ychoufha), w hébergement (API cloud wala serveur mte3ek). Ma fama 'a7sen model' fel motla9: fama a7sen model l mohemma mo3ayna b budget mo3ayen.

Tari9a 3amaliya: ebda b model 9wi (Opus 5.5) bech tchouf el plafond mta3 el qualité. Ba3d a3mel jeu de tests sghir men amthila s7a7 (20 wala 50 cas) w jarreb 3lihom Sonnet 5.5 w Haiku 5.5. Ken el model el rkhis yjib nafs el natija 3la el cas mte3ek, 5oudh el rkhis. W tnajem tkhallat: Haiku y classi el tickets w Opus yjaweb 3la el s3ab. Fakker zeda elli el cost el s7i7 houwa cost el mohemma el kamla: model rkhis yghlot w t3awed 3 marrat ynajem ykoun a8la.
points: Opus 5.5 = el par défaut; Sonnet 5.5 = el wost; Haiku 5.5 = rkhis w sri3; Fable 5.1 = el akwa.
Open models = kontrol w privacy, ama GPU w maintenance.
Jarreb 3la amthila mte3ek, mouch 3la classements mta3 el internet.
9is cost el mohemma el kamla, mouch prix el token wa7dou.

example.note: Routage sghir: kol mohemma 3andha el model elli ykfiha, w el choix yet9arrer b tests.

lessons.title: Hallucinations: 3lech el model yghlot w kifech tna99es
text: Hallucination hiya ki el model ya3tik ma3louma ghalta b thi9a kamla: référence mouch mawjouda, fonction ma fammech menha fi librairie, ar9am mekhtar3in, 9anoun mouch s7i7. Sbabha fel tari9a elli yekhdem biha: y9ayyem texte m3a9oul, mouch yverifi fi base de données. Ken el ma3louma ne9sa, el model ghaleb el wa9t ykammel b 7aja tbén s7i7a 3oudh ma y9oul 'ma na3refch'.

Akther el 7alet elli tsir fihom: so2el 3la 7ajet s8ar w mouch ma3roufin (charika sghira tounsiya, 9anoun jdid), ar9am w dates b dhabt, sources w références, w el ma3loumet elli jet ba3d el knowledge cutoff. Zid 3liha el prompt el ghamedh: ken ma 9oultlouch chnoua yesta3mel w chnoua lé, ykammel men 3andou.

Kifech tna99es: awwalan el grounding: 7ott el documents el s7a7 fel prompt w 9ollou yjaweb ken men el documents hedhom. Hedhi el fekra mta3 RAG elli bech nchoufouha ba3d. Thanyan: a3tih el permission bech y9oul 'ma na3refch' w 9ollou chnoua y9oul b dhabt. Thalethan: otlob menou yjib el jomla elli 3tamed 3liha men el document, bech tnajem tverifi. Rabe3an: ki tnajem, verifi b code: el JSON valide? el fonction mawjouda? el 7sab s7i7?

El 9a3da el dhahbiya: ma t3ammelch 3la el jaweb 3la el 3ama, surtout fi 7ajet fihom flous, sa77a, 9anoun wala décisions 3la 3bed. El AI engineer el behi yebni system fih verification: tests, evaluation 3la amthila, w insen y3awed ychouf ki el risque kbir. W 9oul lel users el s7i7: el AI ynajem yghlot.
points: Hallucination = jaweb ghalet b thi9a; 7aja normale fel LLM, mouch bug nadir.
Grounding: a3tih el source w 9ollou yjaweb menha ken.
Permission b 'ma na3refch' + citation mta3 el source = verification ashel.
Verifi b code w b insen 7asb el risque.

lessons.title: Awel appel l Claude b Python
text: El installation: pip install anthropic (a7sen fi environnement virtuel). Ba3d lezmek API key men el Console mta3 Anthropic. Bech t5alles, el compte yotlob carte de paiement internationale; fi Tounes barcha yesta3mlou carte technologique internationale wala carte mta3 el charika. El key hedhi secret kima mot de passe: elli ya5edha ynajem yesta3mel el compte mte3ek 3la 7sebek.

3lech environment variable? 5ater el code ymchi l Git, lel collègues, l GitHub, w key mektouba fel code tetsarre9 fissa3. El SDK y9ra wa7dou ANTHROPIC_API_KEY men el environnement. Fi Linux wala macOS: export ANTHROPIC_API_KEY=... ; fi PowerShell: $env:ANTHROPIC_API_KEY = "..." ; wala fichier .env elli tzidou fi .gitignore.

El appel: client = anthropic.Anthropic(), ba3d client.messages.create b model, max_tokens (el 7add el a9sa mta3 el output) w messages: liste fiha dictionnaires {role, content}, w el awel dima 'user'. Tnajem tzid system bech ta3ti el dour w el 9wa3ed. El API ma tetfakkarch: bech ta3mel conversation, tzid el jaweb b role 'assistant' w tab3ath kol chay marra o5ra. Ma t7ottech temperature wala prefill copiyé men tutorials 9dom: el models el jdod yerfdhouhom b erreur 400. Bech tkontroli el 3om9 w el cost, fama output_config={"effort": ...} (fi Opus 5.5 el par défaut medium).

El jaweb: response.content liste mta3 blocks (text, thinking, tool_use...), donc chouf block.type 9bal ma t9ra .text. response.usage fih input_tokens w output_tokens. W 9bal kol chay chouf response.stop_reason: 'end_turn' kammel normal, 'max_tokens' el jaweb t9ass (kabbar max_tokens), 'tool_use' y7eb yesta3mel outil, 'refusal' rfodh. El SDK y3awed wa7dou ki ykoun 429 wala 5xx, w tnajem tched erreurs kima anthropic.AuthenticationError wala anthropic.RateLimitError.
points: pip install anthropic, w el key fi ANTHROPIC_API_KEY, 3omrha fel code.
messages.create = model + max_tokens + messages (+ system).
Chouf stop_reason 9bal ma t9ra el content, w block.type 9bal .text.
usage y9ollek 9addech t5alles: sajjlou men el awel.

example.note: Appel kamel: system, message, verification mta3 stop_reason, lecture mta3 el texte w el usage.

lessons.title: Data, privacy w mas2ouliya
text: Kol chay tab3thou l API yo5rej men 3andek w yemchi l serveurs mta3 fournisseur. 9bal ma tab3ath, es2el: el data hedhi lezem el model ychoufha? Données personnelles (asmé, numérouwét, adresses, numéro CIN, données santé wala bancaires), secrets (API keys, mots de passe), w code wala documents confidentiels mta3 el charika: ma yetb3athouch ken ma fammech 7aja w permission.

El charikat 3andhom 9wa3ed: ba3dhom ma ysam7ouch b ay outil AI, ba3dhom ysam7ou b fournisseur wa7ed b contrat, ba3dhom yotolbou model open fel serveurs mte3hom. Fi Ouroba fama RGPD, w fi Tounes fama 9anoun 7imeyet el données personnelles w el INPDP. Inti ka junior, ma t7ottch data mta3 client fi outil AI 'bech tjarreb' bla ma tes2el. Es2el 9bal, dima.

Tari9a 3amaliya: na99es el data (ab3ath ken elli lezem), 5abbi el données personnelles b placeholders kima [EMAIL] w [PHONE] 9bal el appel, ma t5allich el logs fihom textes kamlin mta3 users bla sabab, w a3ref chnoua el fournisseur ya3mel bel data (rétention, contrat). El masking b regex bdaya mli7a ama mouch kamla: el asmé mathalan s3ib bech tal9ahom b regex.

El mas2ouliya zeda: el models ynajmou y3awdou biais elli fel data mta3 el training (3la jens, asl, lougha...). Ma t5allich model ya5ou wa7dou décision tetla3 3la 3bed (recrutement, crédit) bla contrôle insen. W kon wadha7 m3a el users: 9ollhom elli homa yahdrou m3a AI, mouch m3a insen, w elli el jaweb ynajem yghlot. El transparence hedhi tebni el thi9a, w fi blayes barcha wallet obligation.
points: Ab3ath el minimum; 5abbi el données personnelles 9bal el API.
Es2el 3la 9wa3ed el charika 9bal ma testa3mel ay outil AI.
El biais mawjoud: el décisions el sensibles lezemhom insen.
9oul lel users elli homa yahdrou m3a AI.

example.code:
import re

def mask_personal_data(text: str) -> str:
    # Replace e-mails and Tunisian phone numbers before sending text to an external API
    text = re.sub(r"[\w.+-]+@[\w-]+\.[\w.]+", "[EMAIL]", text)
    text = re.sub(r"(\+216\s?)?\b\d{2}\s?\d{3}\s?\d{3}\b", "[PHONE]", text)
    return text

ticket = "Client Sami, sami.benali@example.com, tel +216 22 123 456, cannot log in."
print(mask_personal_data(ticket))
# Client Sami, [EMAIL], tel [PHONE], cannot log in.
example.note: El esm 'Sami' ba9i: el regex bdaya, mouch protection kamla.

lessons.title: Kifech tet3allem w tet7assen: projets w portfolio
text: El AI yetbaddel b sor3a: models jdod, fonctionnalités jdod, w tutorials ywalliw 9dom fi ach-hor. Donc el skill el akbar houwa tet3allem wa7dek. A9ra el documentation el rasmiya mta3 el fournisseur 9bal el articles w el videos, 5ater hiya elli tetbaddel m3a el API. Ki tal9a tutorial yesta3mel paramètre ma 3adech yemchi (kima temperature 3la Claude el jdid), ta3ref 3lech.

El practice: projets s8ar w kamlin a7sen men projet kbir ma yekmelch. Amthila: classificateur mta3 tickets support (derja, fransawi, 3arbi), outil y5arrej ma3loumet men factures PDF l JSON, chatbot yjaweb men documentation mta3 produit, script y9arren el cost mta3 3 models 3la nafs el mohemma. Kol projet ywarri skill: prompt, API, evaluation, cost.

El portfolio: kol projet 3la GitHub b README wadha7: el mochkla, kifech yekhdem, el natayej (9addech s7i7 3la 9addech men mithel, 9addech yekallef), el limites, w kifech tlansih. Ma t7ottech el API key fel repo: .env fi .gitignore. Recruteur fi Ouroba yfaddel projet sghir m9ayyes b ar9am 3la 10 projets chatbot ma fihom 7atta test.

Organisation: 5 l 7 swaye3 fel jom3a 3la el track hedha t5allik tet9addem mli7. Kol cours: a9ra el lessons, a3mel el exercises b yeddik, w zid 7aja sghira men 3andek. El internet ta9ta3? 7adher el code w el prompts offline w jarreb el appels ki yerja3. W bech ma t5allesch barcha w inti tet3allem: Haiku 5.5 lel tajarib, max_tokens sghir, w chouf el usage. W ma tensech el community: meetups w groupes tech tounsiya ynajmou y3awnouk tal9a mentor, feedback 3la projets mte3ek w opportunitÃ©s.
points: Documentation rasmiya 9bal ay tutorial.
Projets s8ar kamlin, kol wa7ed fih skill wadha7.
README b natayej m9aysa w limites = portfolio y7arrek.
Tajarib b Haiku 5.5 w max_tokens sghir bech tna99es el cost.

# Support ticket classifier (Claude API)

## Problem
Classify customer tickets written in Derja, French or Arabic into 5 categories.

## How it works
Python + anthropic SDK, model claude-haiku-5-5, prompt in prompts/classify.txt.
Personal data is masked before each API call.

## Results
Tested on 100 labelled tickets: accuracy, cost per 1,000 tickets, average latency.

## Limits
Tickets mixing languages and slang are harder to classify.

## Run it
pip install -r requirements.txt
Set ANTHROPIC_API_KEY in your environment, then run: python classify.py

exercises.q: Requête fiha 3 000 token input w 800 token output 3la claude-sonnet-5-5. 9addech tekallef? W 9addech ken 3andek 5 000 requête fel nhar?
exercises.hint: Sonnet 5.5: 2$ input w 10$ output l kol milyoun token.
exercises.answer: Input: 3 000 × 2 / 1 000 000 = 0.006$. Output: 800 × 10 / 1 000 000 = 0.008$. Requête wa7da = 0.014$. 5 000 requête = 70$ fel nhar, ya3ni ta9riban 2 100$ fel chhar (30 nhar).

exercises.q: Ekteb fonction read_answer(response) traja3 el texte mta3 el jaweb, traja3 None ki ykoun refusal, w t5arrej avertissement ki el jaweb t9ass.

exercises.q: Fasser fi 3 jomal el far9 bin AI engineer w ML engineer, kima tfasserha fi entretien.
exercises.answer: El ML engineer ydarreb models (des fois men el sfer) w y déployihom, w yekhdem 3la data, features w GPU. El AI engineer yesta3mel models jahzin kima Claude 3abr API w yebni bihom produit: prompts, intégration, evaluation, cost w production. El zouz developers, ama el AI engineer ykhammem akther fel produit w fel comportement mta3 el LLM, mouch fel training.

exercises.q: Ekhtar model l kol cas w 3allel: (a) classification mta3 200 000 email fel nhar, (b) assistant yraja3 contrats twal, (c) chatbot support 3adi.
exercises.hint: Fakker fel volume, fel s3oubiya w fel cost.
exercises.answer: (a) claude-haiku-5-5: volume kbir w mohemma bsita, el cost w el vitesse homa el mouhemmin. (b) claude-opus-5-5: documents twal w raisonnement s3ib; claude-fable-5-1 ken el qualité ma kfetch. (c) claude-sonnet-5-5 kbdaya, ba3d tjarreb Haiku 5.5 3la amthila mte3ek. exercises.q: Ekteb code y7seb el tokens mta3 fichier report.txt 9bal ma tab3thou, w y9ayyem el cost mta3 el input 3la Opus 5.5.
exercises.hint: client.messages.count_tokens b nafs el model, w 4$ l kol milyoun token input.
exercises.answer:
import anthropic

client = anthropic.Anthropic()

with open("report.txt", encoding="utf-8") as f:
    text = f.read()

count = client.messages.count_tokens(
    model="claude-opus-5-5",
    messages=[{"role": "user", "content": text}],
)
input_cost = count.input_tokens * 4 / 1_000_000  # Opus 5.5: 4 USD per million input tokens
print(count.input_tokens, "tokens, about", round(input_cost, 4), "USD of input")

exercises.q: Ticket support fih: esm el client, email, numéro de téléphone, numéro de carte bancaire, w wasf el mochkla. Chnoua tab3ath l API bech tclassih?
exercises.answer: Ken wasf el mochkla, ba3d ma t5abbi fih ay donnée personnelle (email, téléphone, esm) b placeholders. Numéro el carte bancaire 3omrou ma yetb3ath. El esm, el email w el téléphone ma lezmhomch el classification: t5allihom 3andek w tarbothom b el natija b identifiant mta3 el ticket.

pitfalls: Tekteb el API key fel code wala t7ottha fi GitHub: el key tetsarre9 w el facture 3lik. Dima environment variable w .env fi .gitignore.
T9ra response.content[0].text directement: el awel block mouch dima texte, w ken stop_reason 'refusal' wala 'max_tokens' el jaweb mouch kamel.
T3ammel 3la el jaweb 3la el 3ama: ar9am, références w fonctions lezem verification, surtout fel 7ajet el sensibles.
Tab3ath document kamel wala historique twil m3a kol requête bla ma t9is: el cost yetla3 b sor3a. Chouf usage men el nhar el awel.
Tab3ath données personnelles wala code confidentiel l API bla 7aja w bla permission mta3 el charika.
Tcopi code men tutorial 9dim (temperature, prefill, model id b date): el models el jdod yerfdhouh b erreur 400.
T7seb el tokens mta3 Claude b tiktoken: el 3dad ghalet; esta3mel usage wala count_tokens.

interview.q: Chnoua el far9 bin AI engineer w ML engineer?
interview.a: El ML engineer ydarreb w y déployi models, w yekhdem 3la data w training. El AI engineer yebni produits b models jahzin 3abr API: prompts, intégration fel application, evaluation, cost w monitoring. Fel junior, el AI engineer lezmou réflexes mta3 software engineer akther men maths mta3 training.

Token bout mta3 texte (kelma, nos kelma, ponctuation) elli el model y9rah w yekteb bih. El context window, el max_tokens w el facturation kolhom b tokens, donc twoul el prompt w el jaweb y2atthrou direct 3la el cost w 3la el latence. El texte b lougha ghir el anglais ghaleb el wa9t ya5ou tokens akther.

interview.q: 3lech LLM y hallucini, w kifech tna99es el risque?
interview.a: 5ater y9ayyem el texte el a9rab l chnoua t3allem, mouch yverifi fi source. Nna99es b grounding (n7ott el documents fel prompt w n9ollou yjaweb menhom ken), n3tih el permission y9oul 'ma na3refch', notlob citation mta3 el source, w nverifi b code wala b insen 7asb el risque. W na3mel evaluation 3la amthila 9bal el production.

interview.q: Kifech t9ayyem el cost el chahri mta3 chatbot?
interview.a: N9is el moyenne mta3 input w output tokens l kol requête (b usage fi prototype, wala count_tokens), nedhrabhom fel prix mta3 el model (mathalan Opus 5.5 4$ / 20$ l kol milyoun), w nedhrab fi 3dad el requêtes fel chhar. Ma nensech elli el historique yekber m3a kol message. Ba3d nchouf el leviers: model arkhess l ba3dh el mohemmat, prompt a9sar, caching, batch.

interview.q: Kifech ta5tar bin model kbir w model sghir?
interview.a: Nebda b model 9wi bech na3ref el plafond mta3 el qualité, na3mel jeu de tests men cas s7a7, w njarreb el models el arkhess 3lih. Nekhou el arkhess elli ywassel lel niveau el matloub. N7seb cost el mohemma el kamla: model rkhis yghlot w y3awed ynajem ykoun a8la.

interview.q: Chnoua houwa el context window, w chnoua ysir ki el conversation twoul barcha?
interview.a: Houwa el 3dad el a9sa mta3 tokens fi requête wa7da: system, historique, documents w output. Ki el conversation twoul, el cost w el latence yekbrou, w ken nfoutou el 7add el requête ma tet9ebelch. Ndabbrou rousna: n9assou wala nlakhsou el historique el 9dim, w nab3athou ken el documents elli lezmin.

interview.q: Kifech t7mi el API key w el data mta3 el users?
interview.a: El key fi environment variable wala secret manager, 3omrha fel code wala fel repo, w key l kol environnement. Lel data: nab3ath el minimum, n5abbi el données personnelles 9bal el appel, ma nsajjelch textes kamlin fel logs bla sabab, w n7taram 9wa3ed el charika w el 9awanin kima RGPD.

interview.q: El API mta3 Claude tetfakker el conversation? Kifech ta3mel chatbot b barcha messages?
interview.a: Le, el Messages API stateless. El application hiya elli t5abbi el historique w tab3thou kamel m3a kol requête: messages b role 'user' w 'assistant' b el tartib. Ma3neha el input yekber m3a kol tour, w hedha lezem nkhammou fih fel cost.
